name: Paramus Park
summary: Paramus Park is an upscale multi-level enclosed mall featuring more than 100 specialty shops, department stores, and dining options beneath an elegant glass ceiling. Located in Bergen County's premier shopping district, the center offers a sophisticated retail experience with family-friendly amenities including a children's play area and diverse restaurant options.
demographics: Paramus Park attracts a diverse, affluent suburban demographic from Bergen County and surrounding areas of northern New Jersey, one of the wealthiest regions in the United States. The primary trade area consists of middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes significantly above the national average, drawn by the tax-free shopping advantage New Jersey offers on clothing and footwear. Shoppers span multiple generations, from young families utilizing the children's play area to older adults seeking department store shopping, with a strong representation of professionals aged 35-65. The center benefits from Paramus's position as a major retail destination, attracting both local residents and visitors from New York City and throughout the tri-state area seeking quality brands and convenient shopping experiences.
description: Paramus Park stands as a premier shopping destination in Bergen County, New Jersey, offering visitors a sophisticated multi-level enclosed mall experience beneath an elegant glass ceiling that floods the interior with natural light. With more than 100 specialty shops and beloved department stores, this upscale retail center has established itself as a cornerstone of Paramus's reputation as one of the nation's top shopping destinations. The mall's thoughtfully curated tenant mix includes upscale retailers alongside popular national brands, providing shoppers with diverse options for fashion, accessories, home goods, and more. Families appreciate the dedicated children's play area where kids can enjoy themselves while parents take a well-deserved break from shopping. The dining experience at Paramus Park ranges from quick-serve options perfect for a shopping break to full-service restaurants ideal for leisurely meals, making it easy to spend an entire day exploring everything the center has to offer. The mall's prime location at 700 Paramus Park in the heart of Bergen County's retail corridor, combined with its climate-controlled comfort and ample amenities, ensures a pleasant shopping experience year-round. With convenient hours operating from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM most days and strong ratings reflecting customer satisfaction, Paramus Park continues to serve as a beloved gathering place for the community and a must-visit destination for serious shoppers throughout the region.
